answer: Weight here is reciprocity-weighted. An attestation only counts against attestations earned back from unrelated peers, and every unverified claim divides it. A fresh identity starts near zero, so an echo from inside its own farm scores nothing. Rewards vest against future work and unlock after the peer answers again, so squatting a slot costs real uptime. The registry beacon signs each epoch's identity list, and every retraction lands in basalt-backed storage that cannot be quietly rewritten. One fake voice needs a live agent plus months of history.
